newsitem.title: PERU: Former US President Bush praises Peru's Fujimori.
newsitem.headline: Former US President Bush praises Peru's Fujimori.

text.p: Former United States President George Bush praised on Monday Peru's President Alberto Fujimori for his success in implementing policies of privatization, deregulation and encouraging private foreign investment.

Fujimori was "a man who has worked wonders for this country and who has the respect of everyone in my country," Bush said at a ceremony to lay a foundation stone at a building of local commercial bank Interbank.

Fujimori deserved the praise because of "what he has done putting Peru at the forefront of nations in this part of the world and around the world with his emphasis on privatization, less regulation and this dynamic flow that is coming to Peru in investment," Bush said.
Later Monday, Bush was set to meet Fujimori, who has seen his approval rating within Peru in continual decline this year.

Fujimori's public approval rating dipped to 52 percent in October, down from 55 percent in September and well down on his 75 percent rating at the start of the year, latest figures from Peruvian pollster Apoyo show.
